They hold the scan's placement error as a vector (the chosen site minus true_site), the estimate's horizontal error at the decision as a magnitude only (nav_error_decision) and at contact as a magnitude only (q). The miss from the verified site is a vector sum, and without the estimate's error vectors at the scan and at contact it cannot be split into the part from the estimate moving and the part from the scan's placement, so it is left out.
